pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions (pyramiding) within 0.1% of local volatility bands or into high-velocity momentum wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe order flow imbalance check and ATR-based volatility envelope confirmation prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive partial or full profit sweeps (SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST) the moment floating profits hit the $15.00 threshold to prevent evaporation.
